sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "user_type" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'employee', "onboarding_done" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("onboarding_done" IN (0, 1)), "car_allowance_ore_per_mil" INTEGER NULL, "locale_code" TEXT NULL, "last_backup_utc" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trips" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_utc" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_utc" TEXT NOT NULL, "start_tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_tz" TEXT NOT NULL, "country" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Sverige', "confirmed_business_trip" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("confirmed_business_trip" IN (0, 1)), "confirmed50km" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("confirmed50km" IN (0, 1)), "night_worker" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("night_worker" IN (0, 1)), "employer_pays_per_diem" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("employer_pays_per_diem" IN (0, 1)), "breakfast" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "lunch" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "dinner" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'none', "lodging" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'standard', "continues_trip_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES trips (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_utc" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_segments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "trip_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES trips (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "country_name" TEXT NULL, "country_code" TEXT NULL, "start_utc" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_utc" TEXT NOT NULL, "tz" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trip_days" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "trip_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES trips (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "breakfast" TEXT NULL, "lunch" TEXT NULL, "dinner" TEXT NULL, "lodging" TEXT NULL, "lodging_cost_ore" INTEGER NULL, "country_override" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("trip_id", "date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "employer_payments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "trip_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES trips (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_ore" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("trip_id", "kind"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vehicles" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "label" TEXT NOT NULL, "registration" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "ownership" TEXT NOT NULL, "powertrain" TEXT NOT NULL, "employer_pays_fuel" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("employer_pays_fuel" IN (0, 1)), "only_workplace_charging" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("only_workplace_charging" IN (0, 1)), "archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("archived" IN (0, 1)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "mileage_entries" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "vehicle_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id), "trip_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES trips (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "odo_start" INTEGER NULL, "odo_end" INTEGER NULL, "distance_m" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "to_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "purpose" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "visited" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "congestion_tax_ore" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "toll_ore" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "allowance_ore_per_mil" INTEGER NULL, "created_utc" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "commute_routes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "label" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "vehicle_id" INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES vehicles (id), "one_way_m" INTEGER NOT NULL, "work_days" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '1,2,3,4,5', "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "created_utc" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "commute_days" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "date" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "commuted" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("commuted" IN (0, 1)), "reason" TEXT NULL, "route_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES commute_routes (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "one_way_m" INTEGER NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "commute_expenses" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "recurrence" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_ore" INTEGER NOT NULL, "from_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_date" TEXT NULL, "route_id" INTEGER NULL REFERENCES commute_routes (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "created_utc" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "owner_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "file_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_utc" TEXT NOT NULL);
